scope: Proposition 4.3 of the manuscript “The entropy photon-number inequality” (preprints/The-entropy-photon-number-inequality-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 273 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d826f8ebe1859641), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For i = 1, 2, the slice map on the centered output space satisfies ∥LiZ∥2 i ≤ 1 + ε 1 − κ ∥Z∥2 0. (4.10) It consequently extends continuously to the completed centered spaces. For bounded observables this extension agrees with (4.9).
